summary: Frontend-only retest (375x667) of the Prajeta Customer Expo app against PRODUCTION backend https://fleetride-hub.emergent.host. All 5 fixes from iteration 20 verified PASS, regression PASS. (1) Direct hard-load of /book/hourly at 19:42 UTC: the displayed slot is 'Today, 9:00 PM' and the fare-estimate body sends time '21:00' (effTime), not the raw '10:00'. Choosing 22:00 sends time '22:00', and the fare goes from Rs518 to Rs778 because of the night surcharge. (2) Changing the date to Mon 2 Nov refetches the fare with date '2026-11-02'. (3) The own-code rejection toast 'You can't use your own referral code' shows with the error background rgb(229,57,53). (4) Contact name is pre-filled with 'Ananya Shah (Demo Customer)' on a direct load. (5) Home page: exactly 1 GET /api/bookings/pending-review (404) in 52s, with no retries and no 20s polling. Regression: the UI login 9000000003/123456 lands on /customer. Referral code PRJ8YK6Z. The More share text and the WhatsApp share URL both include <origin>/?ref=PRJ8YK6Z. Opening /?ref=PRJ8YK6Z saves pending_ref and redirects to /customer. On /book/hourly the code is auto-applied (400), then the field is cleared ('Apply'), pending_ref is removed, the fare is Rs518 and 'Review & Pay Rs104 Advance' is enabled. No bookings were created. No deprecated Expo packages were seen in the reviewed files.

minor.issue: Production still returns 404 (older backend deploy). The app now handles this gracefully: 1 call per app load.

issues: INFO: without a ?city param the city defaults to cities[0] (Bengaluru), while the home header showed Mumbai. This is the same as before and only affects deep links or hard loads.

action_items: OPTIONAL/INFO: on direct /book links, default the city to the user's selected city instead of cities[0].
INFO: the first login attempt hit 'Too many OTP requests. Please wait 10 minutes.' on production, probably from main-agent logins just before. The login worked after waiting.
critical_code_review_comments: book/[serviceId].tsx: the fare request fires once with coupon=null before getPendingReferral resolves, then again with the link code. This is harmless (cached) and adds one extra request.
seed_data_creation: None. No bookings were created on production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Production backend. The demo customer's own referral code is PRJ8YK6Z. The OTP rate limit is strict: log in once via the UI, read localStorage 'auth_token' (a JSON string), and inject it into later browser sessions with localStorage.setItem before page.goto. pending_ref is localStorage key 'pending_ref'. Browser TZ is UTC.
